subject: Invoice pending collection — unexpectedly high tokens (Jun 18–19) and telemetry sample request
messages:
From: Eliot Tran <eliot.tran@acmelabs.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Labs Billing <billing@acmelabs.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice pending collection — unusual token spike Jun 18-19

Hi Sergio,

We received a collection notice for the June invoice (attached). Our finance team flagged a large token spike between Jun 18 23:00 UTC and Jun 19 03:00 UTC that we don't recognize — usage jumped ~4.7M tokens over the ~4-hour window. We run nightly backfills but that magnitude looks wrong for our workload.

Can you share the raw meter slice around that window (request ids, model variant used, and any telemetry that would show repeated replays)? Also, does Redwood provide provisional credits while investigations happen? We're in the middle of month-end and need to avoid payment hold impacting our service.

PO: ACME-PO-9943
Contact on copy: billing@acmelabs.com

Thanks,
Eliot
Eliot Tran
Head of Platform Engineering — Acme Labs
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
Attachment: acme_invoice_jun2028.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Tran <eliot.tran@acmelabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice pending collection — unusual token spike Jun 18-19

Hi Eliot — thanks for the heads up and attaching the invoice. I've looped in Kimberly (Finance) and Ben (Billing ops) so we can coordinate telemetry and a provisional credit if warranted.

Initial ask from our side: can you confirm whether any backfill or bulk-replay jobs were running from your infra in UTC timezone near 23:00–03:00? Also, if you have any request ids or internal job ids from your side, include them — they help us correlate.

Ben — can you pull the prebill telemetry slice for ACME for 2028-06-18 22:30 UTC through 2028-06-19 04:30 UTC and share a sample CSV of request ids and model variants? Kimberly, we'll need a quick provisional credit recommendation if the spike looks internal to our ingestion.

Eliot — we'll aim to get a preliminary telemetry sample back in ~24 hours. If the spike is due to an ingest/replay duplication on our side we'll propose a provisional credit while we complete a full reconciliation.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Account Success — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 510-555-0222
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Eliot Tran <eliot.tran@acmelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice pending collection — unusual token spike Jun 18-19

Team — attaching the prebill sample from our aggregation pipeline. Quick summary of what I see:

- Window: 2028-06-18T22:58:00Z to 2028-06-19T03:07:00Z shows 4.6M extra tokens vs baseline.
- Root cause (prelim): a replay/backfill job from an external job runner caused duplicated request IDs to be ingested due to TTL alignment on our front-proxy (requests retried + continuous batching coalesced them into repeated tokens).
- Model: majority of spikes are on rwd-open-7b-quant (cpu fallback variant engaged for a subset which changes token accounting).

I attached: prebill-telemetry-sample.csv (first 250 rows) and a provisional-credit-proposal.xlsx with a suggested 40% credit on the delta while we finish a full forensic replay (we picked 40% conservatively to account for partial legitimate traffic).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Approve provisional credit amount so Finance can apply a credit memo and avoid collection hold.
2) We run a full replay correlate (48–72 hours) to confirm exact duplicate attribution.
3) If confirmed, issue final credit and adjust June invoice; if not confirmed, we re-open with specifics.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachment: prebill-telemetry-sample.csv (CSV, 34KB); provisional-credit-proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)
From: Eliot Tran <eliot.tran@acmelabs.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Labs Billing <billing@acmelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 12:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice pending collection — unusual token spike Jun 18-19

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick triage and the sample. The telemetry looks consistent with a replay storm; that matches internal correlates we found where an ETL job re-run overlapped with a connector retry.

ACME accepts the provisional credit proposal for now to avoid payment disruption. A couple of notes for Finance:
- Please apply credit to the Jun invoice and issue a credit memo referencing PO ACME-PO-9943.
- EU VAT: this invoice is billed to our US entity, but we may need documentation for our AP team if you apply a retroactive adjustment. If you can include the credit memo + a short note that the adjustment is non-taxable correction, that helps.
- Timeline: can you confirm when the credit memo posts and whether the collection notice will be retracted?

Thanks — Eliot
Eliot Tran
Head of Platform Engineering — Acme Labs
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Tran <eliot.tran@acmelabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice pending collection — unusual token spike Jun 18-19

Eliot — thanks for confirming. Action items and timeline from Redwood:

- Finance (Kimberly): we'll issue a provisional credit memo for 40% of the delta (per Ben's proposal) and apply it to the Jun invoice. Kimberly — can you confirm the credit memo number and whether Collections will retract the hold once applied?
- Billing Ops (Ben): continue the forensic correlation — prioritize request-id de-duplication and a final delta report. Aim to deliver the final reconciliation within 72 hours.
- Documentation: we'll include a short statement with the credit memo indicating this is a post-bill correction (non-taxable adjustment) to help your AP team with VAT handling.

Eliot — expected outcomes: provisional credit applied within 2 business days; final reconciliation and any additional credit (if confirmed) within 3 business days after that. If Collections requires a formal hold retraction, I'll follow up with the collections lead and confirm via this thread.

Thanks again for the quick coordination — we'll get this resolved and share the final reconciliation.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Account Success — Redwood Inference
